name: @agentic-dna/app-template
description: The agent onboarding kit: Vite + TS + React 19 client, Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL server, @agentic-dna/server-core pre-wired (R-PKG-09). Scaffold a new app from this template; this manifest is renamed by scripts/scaffold.mjs.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm db:generate && tsc -p template/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p template/client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm db:generate && node --import tsx --test template/server/src/app.test.ts template/server/src/openapi.test.ts template/server/src/permissions.test.ts template/server/src/errorCodes.test.ts template/server/src/contract-conformance.test.ts template/client/src/auth/authClient.test.ts
scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && tsc -p template/server/tsconfig.build.json && vite build template/client
scripts.check:quality-gate: pnpm check:whitespace && pnpm check:design-tokens && pnpm check:contrast && pnpm check:layering && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:bundle-secrets
